name: M01 revealed server seed corrupted
guard: Step 1 opens every per-round commitment: a revealed seed that does not hash to its serverSeedHash is the failure commit-reveal exists to detect.

name: M01b one round dropped from the capture
guard: Step 1 counts the commitments it opened against EXPECTED_ROUNDS in src/loader.ts, so a truncated capture fails instead of shrinking its own denominator.

name: M02 bet accepted after the beacon published
guard: Step 2 requires every bet to be accepted strictly before its drand beacon was published; a non-positive margin is a round whose beacon could have been known.
replace: const rounds = ds.rounds; rounds[10].timing.betPlacedAt = rounds[10].timing.drandPublishedAt * 1000 + 500; rounds[10].timing.commitmentBeforeDrand = -500; // MUTATION

name: M02b a client-clock timestamp slipped in
guard: Step 2 binds the timestamp provenance: a capture-only (client clock) row is weaker evidence and fails the declared transactions-api population.

name: M03 beacon round re-used out of order
guard: Step 3 requires drand rounds strictly increasing in capture order, so no beacon was re-used or taken out of order.
replace: const rounds = ds.rounds; rounds[5].result.drandRoundId = rounds[4].result.drandRoundId; // MUTATION

name: M04 one commitment serving two rounds
guard: Step 4 requires one fresh commitment per round against EXPECTED_DISTINCT_SEEDS.
replace: const rounds = ds.rounds; rounds[21].result.serverSeed = rounds[20].result.serverSeed; rounds[21].result.serverSeedHash = rounds[20].result.serverSeedHash; // MUTATION

name: M05 served crash point nudged by one hundredth
guard: Step 5 recomputes every crash point by exact equality.
replace: const rounds = ds.rounds; rounds[30].result.crashPoint = Math.round(rounds[30].result.crashPoint * 100 + 1) / 100; // MUTATION

name: M05b served-grid floor guard
guard: Step 5 asserts every served crash point is on the 2-dp grid at or above the declared floor in its own right, not only through the recomputation: raising the declared floor to 1.50 must fail it while every recomputation still matches.

name: M05c docs-site derive.js forged AND re-pinned
guard: Step 5 executes the vendored docs-site verifier on every round: a derive.js whose logic changed must disagree with the served crash points even when its pin is updated to match.

name: M05d docs-site derive.js edited without re-pin
guard: The vendored site bytes must hash to their pins before anything runs; a one-comment edit that changes no logic still fails.

name: M05e live-site chunk forged AND re-pinned
guard: Step 5 executes the live verify-bets bundle on every round: a chunk whose Duel Crash method prints a different crash point must disagree even when the chunk is re-pinned.

name: M05f live-site chunk edited without re-pin
guard: The vendored live-site bytes must hash to their pins before the runner executes them.

name: M05g operator Verify-tab file logic changed (hex bytes XOR 1) and re-pinned
guard: CRASH-09: forged evidence — Duel's vendored Crash Verify-tab code is changed on an uncited line AND its SHA-256 pin re-computed, so the hash check accepts it; executing it on every round must expose it.

name: M05h operator Verify-tab file byte changed without re-pin
expect: does not match its pinned SHA-256
guard: CRASH-09: the vendored operator file must hash to its pin before it runs.

name: M05i operator runner changed without re-pin
expect: does not match its pinned SHA-256
guard: CRASH-09: the runner that executes the operator file is pinned too.

name: M05j operator runner forged (drops the last beacon byte) and re-pinned
guard: CRASH-09: a re-pinned runner that feeds the operator code the wrong input must be caught by comparing its output with the served crash point and src/rng.ts, not only by the pin.

name: M05k src/rng.ts cites an operator line that does not carry the quoted text
guard: CRASH-09: every citation in src/rng.ts OPERATOR_SOURCE_CITES must quote the pinned operator file at the line it names.

name: M06 Phase C moved to another target in the plan
guard: Step 6 checks Phase C against the declared stake/target plan in src/loader.ts, so the comparison group cannot drift to whatever the data holds.

name: M06b elevated-stake win settled at a worse per-unit return
guard: Step 6 compares the per-unit return of every elevated-stake win with the base-stake wins at the same target, exact on the 6-dp grid.

name: M07 win credited one grid unit high
guard: Step 7 compares every win in integer 6-dp units: one unit off is a different credit.

name: M07b served edge field differs from the declared edge
guard: Step 7 compares the served effectiveEdge with the declared constant on every round instead of reading it into the expected payout.

name: M07c tie settled as a loss
guard: Step 7 checks isWin = crashPoint >= target on every round; a tie (crash == target) settled as a loss breaks the declared boundary.
replace: const rounds = ds.rounds; rounds[261].result.isWin = false; rounds[261].result.amountWon = '0'; // MUTATION

name: M08 edge constant mis-set in the formula
guard: Step 8 decides RTP ≤ 0.999 in integers; an edge constant of 0.05% puts the RTP above the claimed ceiling.

name: M09 a round relabelled into another phase
guard: Step 9 compares per-phase counts with the capture plan in src/loader.ts, not the dataset header.

name: M10 dataset byte changed, pre-flight abort disabled
guard: Step 10 re-asserts the dataset pin on its own, so a verifier whose pre-flight abort was removed still fails a changed dataset.

name: M11 beacon publication time off the chain formula
guard: Step 11 recomputes every beacon's publication time from the quicknet chain formula.

name: M12 independent model mis-wired
guard: Step 12 binds the independent per-value model to every live round and compares its counts with src/rng.ts exactly.

name: M12b negative control neutered
expect: negative control: a map with edge factor 0.998
guard: Step 12's negative control must show the count comparison can fail; a 'wrong' map equal to the true one leaves it with nothing to catch, and the step must say so.

name: M13 Pass 1 Fisher p forged AND re-pinned
guard: Step 13 replays Pass 1 from its seeds and compares every committed scalar with the replay; a forged scalar fails even when the artifact is re-pinned.

name: M14 Pass 2 return forged AND re-pinned
guard: Step 14 replays Pass 2 and compares every committed scalar (here the played-target return in hundredths) with the replay.

name: M14b captured rounds forced to lose (rank rule must fire)
expect: captured rounds lose more often than their own seed's reference
guard: CRASH-21: the pre-registered captured-vs-reference rank rule must be reachable — a seed chosen after its beacon was known shows up as captured rounds losing more often than the seed's reference draws.

name: M14c reference draws paid short (return rule must fire)
expect: the seeds pay less than the exact law at the targets played
guard: CRASH-21: the pre-registered return rule must be reachable — a seed population paying 0.2 % less than the exact law at the played targets is flagged.
replace: deterministicHex('pass2-drand-' + s, d, 48)) >= t * 1.002) wins++; // MUTATION

name: M14d captured round no longer reproduced from its real beacon
expect: captured round(s) not reproduced from their revealed seed and real beacon
guard: CRASH-21: window 0 of the cherry-pick screen is the captured round; the replay must reproduce its served crash point, or the reference is not being compared with what the casino settled.

name: M15 drand API record forged AND re-pinned
guard: Step 15 binds each round's signature to its pinned api.drand.sh record and recomputes the file's counters; a forged record fails even when re-pinned.

name: M16 per-target floor raised above a captured target
guard: Step 16 holds every declared cash-out target to the floor in src/loader.ts; 1.1× has 51 rounds, so a floor of 60 must fail.

name: M16b undeclared cash-out target in the data
guard: Step 16 fails a cash-out target present in the data but absent from the declared plan.
replace: const rounds = ds.rounds; rounds[500].request.auto_cashout = 3; rounds[500].result.isWin = rounds[500].result.crashPoint >= 3; // MUTATION

name: M17 pinned artifact byte appended without re-pin
guard: Step 17 hashes every artifact of record against src/artifact-pins.ts.

name: M17b pinned artifact deleted
guard: An absent artifact of record is a hard fail, not a pass by absence.

name: M17c impossible value written AND re-pinned
guard: Step 17 checks every numeric leaf against src/domains.ts: more captured wins than captured rounds is impossible and must fail even though the artifact is re-pinned. (Step 14's replay also catches it; the marker proves the domain check fired on its own.)

name: M18 live sample sorted before the fit
guard: Step 18 reacts to the sample: a sorted sequence has lag-1 correlation near 1 and must turn the step to INFO (informational: not counted, verdict unchanged; the run is rejected by the reproduction gate because the committed Step 18 record changes).
find: const u = rounds.map(r => valueFromRound(r.result.serverSeed, r.result.drandRandomness) / TWO32);
replace: const u = rounds.map(r => valueFromRound(r.result.serverSeed, r.result.drandRandomness) / TWO32).sort((a, b) => a - b); // MUTATION
